pages.text: The focus shoots a beam of magical energy that's capable of mining the very rock and stone with tougher materials taking longer to mine.
The Potency enchantment increases the speed of mining and on higher levels allows the spell to mine blocks that require diamond or netherite tools.
Casting with $(l:crafts/staff/geo_staff)Geo Staff$() will cause the spell to mine in a 3x3 area, so long as the blocks are mine-able with pickaxe or shovel.
